title: Pointwise local finite presentation descends along a field extension
statement: Let k be a field, K/k a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], f:X\to Y a morphism of k-schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-morphism-conventions], x\in X, and x_K\in X_K a point above x [def-pc-base-change]. If the base-change morphism f_K:X_K\to Y_K is locally of finite presentation on an open neighbourhood of x_K [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], then f is locally of finite presentation on an open neighbourhood of x.
